body.name: Absorbing-support lag graph
body.construction: Suppose every path in \(\mathcal S\) is absorbing.  The graph \(\mathfrak G_{\mathcal S,p}\) has vertex set \(\{\bot,0,\ldots,p\}\).  For every unordered pair of distinct adoption dates \(u_a=a(s_a)\), \(u_b=a(s_b)\), and every \(t\in\{2,\ldots,T\}\), put \(r=t-u_a\) and \(q=t-u_b\).  If \(r,q\in\{0,\ldots,p\}\), add the edge \(\{r,q\}\); if exactly one of \(r,q\) belongs to \(\{0,\ldots,p\}\), join that vertex to \(\bot\); and otherwise add no edge.
